classpathRule: Exact original 126 measured entries, in original order, followed by exactly one directory containing only the unique external launcher class. No original class, source, or resource is overlaid.
failurePolicy: Any nonzero hosting/hard-decline counter, missing audit, incomplete/invalid sample, checksum/ledger failure, changed artifact, or process failure stops the entire confirmation. Preserve all raw data; do not replace or silently remove a fork. No confirmation aggregate is accepted when blocked.

jvm.strategy: normal AUTO; only transport property varies

name: Root-qualified four-arm default-fixture confirmation
preRunCondition: Final 484-class broad gate completed green; no other Java/compiler/test/archive jobs active when timing begins.
preRunReviewCorrections: Require one semantic compilation in every individual query, in addition to absolute and summed totals.
Verify exact Java executable, original driver/freeze driver hashes, and reference classpath manifest hash before timing and preserve the source/manifest checks afterward.
reason: The original timing schema recorded native selections/tiers but not outer-root hosting. This independent confirmation closes that observation gap while preserving the original measured harness and engine bytes.

rootCounterObservation.claimBoundary: Zero HOSTED_GENERIC establishes no generic outer-root host in the new process. It does not reconstruct outer-root choices of earlier protocols or prove the absence of every possible generic interior operator.

monotonicityProof.COMPILED: AtomicLong initialized to zero; production writes are increments after successful root or non-BGP interior compilation
monotonicityProof.HOSTED_GENERIC: AtomicLong initialized to zero; sole production mutation is incrementAndGet in compileHostedPlan after constructing GenericRootPlan
monotonicityProof.UNHOSTED_HARD_DECLINES: AtomicLong initialized to zero; no production mutation or reset path
monotonicityProof.harness: OptionalFanoutExperiment and invoked fixture/telemetry paths never call root counter reset. OptionalFanoutRouteAccess.resetIrKernelMetrics is not invoked by this harness.

rootCounterObservation.requiredCompileCountConsistency: Absolute COMPILED equals the sum of all ten raw semanticNativeCompiles deltas, one per query
rootCounterObservation.scope: Absolute process totals cover every warmup and measurement query in a fresh JVM
rootCounterObservation.when: After original OptionalFanoutExperiment.main has returned or thrown; no pre-main counter read/reset

statistics.pooling: Keep this protocol separate from all earlier protocols and retain all earlier raw results.
statistics.primary: Median of five measured totalNs or allThreadAllocatedBytes within each JVM, then candidate/OFF ratio within each matched round, then median of four round ratios. Report every round and full paired range.
statistics.routeQualification: Require root-host zeros across all160 queries and report observed native selection/tier frequency histograms for measured samples. A histogram mismatch qualifies the interpretation; it does not justify exclusion.
statistics.secondary: Direct CHANGES/DENSE and ROWS/DENSE paired ratios; preparation/evaluation/consumption phase medians; optional last-three measured sensitivity clearly labelled secondary.
